# caller_local_crown_identity

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Binds one admitted upstream crown to the exact caller-local consumer subject; cross-consumer crown reuse is refused.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `consumer_subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact caller-local consumer commit SHA that must be requalified. |
| `receipt_digest` | `string` | yes | Immutable digest of this capability's exact-subject qualification receipt. |
